OCCUPATIONAL ENGLISH TEST
WRITING SUB-TEST                 MEDICINE
TIME :                          READING: 5 MINUTES
                                WRITING : 40 MINUTES


Read the case notes below and complete the writing task which follows.
Notes:
Patient name: Mr Jane Browne
DOB: 25/08/2001
Age : 18
History:
Student
Facial eczema as baby
Flexular eczema as child
Allergic rhinitis to pollens , cat hair
History of asthma (mother)
01/09/2019
Tender ,weepy, crusty nipple
Surrounding inflammation from plaster dressing
Treatment plan:
Hydrocortisone
Soap substitute
 
Ellomite e.g Edomin 5
stop using plaster , replace it with mepor dressing and keep uncovered
except during sport
On 10/9/2019
Showed improvement
Feels happy with the mepor
Advised to return in case of symptoms worsening
On 21/9/2019
Nipple never healed
Increased friction with T-shirts during sport , so cover with mepor
Feels embarrassed after sports dressings room , need complete resolution
Reported use hydrocortisone intermittently
On examination
Nipple was tender , no crustations , change in appearance and become
warty
Diagnosis: ? Seborrheic keratosis
           : ? Eczema
           : ? Others
Plan : refer to a dermatologist for assessment and diagnosis
Writing Task
Using the information in the case notes , write a letter of a referral to Dr
Elizabeth Macnor ,Consultant Dermatologist ,Newtown Hospital , 81
Canyon Road , Newtown.
 
In your answer:
  • Expand the relevant notes into complete sentences.
  • Do not use note form.
  • Use the letter form.
The body of the letter should be approximately 180 – 200 words.
